# v5 results tables (generated by `python -m src.v5.report`; do not edit by hand)

MAE, RMSE, bias (prediction − observation) and max/median absolute error are in percentage points of capacity. Networks: point forecast = mean of the 3 seed medians. Training time: total over the population's folds (networks: 3 seeds, 9 concurrent single-thread workers; tabular: one process, all cores). Each table is one population; numbers are never pooled across tables.
